verso-shell.description: Session grants for Verso's shell-owned pages: the overview meters + WAN graph, the Services table and its start/stop, connected devices, and the network/firewall/zone views. Declares every ubus object and uci config the shell reads or controls, so the shell depends on no other package's ACL files — in particular not LuCI's, which the dev image happens to ship but a production image need not.
